sections.title: About this guide
data: This guide covers two Coast Guard towns on the Straits of Mackinac: Cheboygan, where the icebreaker Mackinaw moors and most of the Coast Guard homes are, and St. Ignace, a small-boat station across the bridge. The home counts come from the Coast Guard's housing map (updated 10/30/2026); the cutter's undated unit information sheet gives the rest and is labelled as such.
Ask your sponsor before you move.

sections.title: Coast Guard Housing
data: The Coast Guard's housing map lists 27 active homes at the Cheboygan housing site and 14 active homes at St. Ignace.

The Mackinaw's unit information sheet (undated) says members who report with dependents are eligible for government housing, that most families live in the 27 Coast Guard-owned units, and that single members without dependents typically live aboard the ship.

In the Coast Guard, assignment to Coast Guard housing is generally mandatory when a home is available, and BAH starts only after the housing office releases you to rent in town. Ask your sponsor for the local housing officer before you look at rentals.
